name: smwpatches-p-balloon-and-cloud-clipping-fix
title: P-Balloon and Cloud Clipping Fix
description:
Fixes the glitch that lets you go though blocks while using a P-balloon or Lakitu cloud, by holding the left and right buttons simultaneously.

Tester's note: That glitch can only occur if you enable pressing left and right at the same time (in your emulator).
